_enforcement_note: Attestation layer only. pre_tool_use_guard.js does NOT consult this file; nothing in code gates skill execution on registry state. Wiring enforcement is a separate later batch behind its own approval. Skills never authorize execution; policies/config/evals remain authority; GBrain is an evidence candidate only, never authority.
_provenance_note: This registry was regenerated for the HarnessKit extraction (Phase 1A, source commit 35df1ac771f303085551dd81cbecd8d459cb4742) rather than copied verbatim from the source repo. Sanitizing skills/* (stripping personal/project-specific content, dropping the project-plan-review skill entirely) invalidates every previously-recorded hash, so every runtime_hash/validation_hash below was freshly computed against the ACTUAL post-sanitization bytes in THIS repo via scripts/validate-skill-registration.js computeHashes() -- never hand-typed, never carried over. Full 11-step attestation review (Gap G4 in the source project's own gap matrix) is a separate, not-yet-done follow-up; this is a hash-integrity baseline only.

_hash_model.design: two-hash closed-by-default partition of skills/<id>/ — no single trust_hash exists by design
_hash_model.validation_hash_domain: tests/** + evals/** (skill-local validation suite only; harness fixtures under evals/fixtures/<category>/ are the harness's, not the skill's)
_hash_model.runtime_hash_domain: every other file in the skill directory (SKILL.md, resolver.*, scripts/**, resources/**, examples/**, and any future file by default)
_hash_model.readme_rule: README* is in runtime_hash by default; excluded only when the record sets readme_excluded_from_runtime_hash: true
_hash_model.algorithm: per domain: normalize relpaths to forward slashes, sort, sha256 each file's bytes, combined = sha256(concat of 'relpath\n<file-sha>\n'), stored as sha256:<hex>
_hash_model.on_validation_hash_mismatch: cannot claim validated — re-review or re-baseline required (runtime not quarantined by this alone)

trusted-local.meaning: authored in-repo by owner, reviewed, helper (if any) reviewed
trusted-local.gate: human review + helper review + evals at threshold

imported.gate: repo-forensics scan + human review; no auto-enable

quarantined.meaning: present but disabled; unreviewed or hash-mismatched

blocked.meaning: security incident; cannot be enabled even by editing frontmatter (hash-pinned, sticky)

retired.meaning: deprecated + removed from routing; tombstoned one batch
